sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_index" USING fts5(title, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix = '2 3');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_map" ("row_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(entity, entity_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_pending" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(entity, entity_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "birthday_day" INTEGER NULL, "birthday_month" INTEGER NULL, "birthday_year" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((birthday_day IS NULL) = (birthday_month IS NULL)), CHECK (birthday_year IS NULL OR birthday_day IS NOT NULL), CHECK (birthday_day IS NULL OR birthday_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31), CHECK (birthday_month IS NULL OR birthday_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contexts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES contexts (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NULL, "revisit_at" TEXT NULL, "requester_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "waiting_on_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "context_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES contexts (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER items_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON items BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('items', new.id);END
CREATE TRIGGER items_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF raw_text, title, body, deleted_at ON items BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('items', new.id);END
CREATE TRIGGER people_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON people BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('people', new.id);END
CREATE TRIGGER people_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF name, note, deleted_at ON people BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('people', new.id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER person_aliases_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON person_aliases BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('people', new.person_id);END

CREATE TRIGGER person_aliases_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF alias, person_id, deleted_at ON person_aliases BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('people', old.person_id);INSERT OR IGNORE INTO search_pending (entity, entity_id) VALUES ('people', new.person_id);END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "pipeline_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((item_id IS NULL) <> (person_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "from_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "to_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "duplicate_dismissals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "other_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (item_id < other_item_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tokens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "token_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_value" TEXT NULL, "parser_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX items_status ON items (status)
CREATE INDEX items_due_at ON items (due_at)
CREATE INDEX items_revisit_at ON items (revisit_at)
CREATE INDEX items_requester_id ON items (requester_id)
CREATE INDEX items_waiting_on_id ON items (waiting_on_id)
CREATE INDEX items_context_id ON items (context_id)
CREATE INDEX person_aliases_person_id ON person_aliases (person_id)
CREATE INDEX person_aliases_alias ON person_aliases (alias COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX contexts_parent_id ON contexts (parent_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tags_name_live ON tags (name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX attachments_item_id ON attachments (item_id)
CREATE INDEX attachments_person_id ON attachments (person_id)
CREATE INDEX item_links_from ON item_links (from_item_id)
CREATE INDEX item_links_to ON item_links (to_item_id)
CREATE INDEX duplicate_dismissals_item_id ON duplicate_dismissals (item_id)
CREATE INDEX duplicate_dismissals_other_id ON duplicate_dismissals (other_item_id)
CREATE INDEX tokens_item_id ON tokens (item_id)
CREATE INDEX tokens_type_value ON tokens (token_type, resolved_value)
CREATE INDEX change_log_hlc ON change_log (hlc)
CREATE INDEX change_log_entity ON change_log (entity, entity_id)
